言安希也坐了起来，连忙用浴袍把自己遮得严严实实。
“很多事我自有安排，不要妄图揣测我。”他丢下这一句话，毫不停留的往外面走去。
言安希看着他大步离开，心里一慌，再也顾不得其他，赶紧赤脚爬下床，追了上去，从后面紧紧的箍住了慕迟曜精壮的腰身。
“我错了，你不要走……我再也不多嘴了，慕迟曜，你说什么就是什么，我绝对没有异议。”
言安希赶紧的认错，要是慕迟曜今晚被她这样的气走了，那她以后的日子，恐怕就不好过了。
慕迟曜手里握着太多她的重要的东西了。
他却冷哼一声，一根一根的掰开她的手指头：“放开。”
言安希不肯：“不要生我的气，我错了我错了，你当我什么都没有说过……”
言安希往后趔趄了两步，才勉强站稳。
慕迟曜已经大步的走了出去，“砰”的一声甩上了房门。
好吧，言安希心想，完了，她真的把他惹生气了。看来，她不该试图去猜测慕迟曜的心思。
那现在他已经走了，也没有办法，她只能明天好好的去哄了？
是的，哄，慕迟曜这个男人，她只能哄，装乖巧。
既然已经走到这一步了，以后再怎么样，她也必须要硬着头皮走下去了。
言安希也没有再去深想，她已经够累了，转身回到床上，没一会儿就已经睡熟了。
慕迟曜回到自己的房间，换了一身衣服，拿上车钥匙，抬手看了一眼时间，已经是深夜十一点了。
他转身走了出去，看见对面紧闭的卧室门的时候，眼睛微微一冷，原本就刚毅的轮廓，顿时更加的冷硬。
慕迟曜走出年华别墅，发动车子，径直驶了出去，片刻都不停留。
慕迟曜把车停下，立刻就有人上前，率先替他打开车门：“慕先生。”
他把车钥匙一扔，随口问道：“有哪些人在？”
慕迟曜微一点头，已经直接走了进去。
这是一家高级的私人VIP酒吧，号称慕城最贵的酒吧。因为来来往往的都是慕城的权贵和慕城的千金小姐，酒吧一百米以内都有保安，一般人都不能轻易靠近。
而这间位于慕城黄金地段的酒吧，不过是慕氏集团旗下的一个不起眼的小产业。
慕迟曜一走进去，就听见有人吹了声口哨：“喲，这不是慕大总裁，今天怎么有空来这里喝一杯？”
吧台前不远处的专属位置上，坐着两个十分矜贵俊美的男人。
吹口哨的是沈北城，沈家大公子，慕迟曜多年的好友。
沈北城旁边的厉衍瑾也抬起头来，淡淡的看了慕迟曜一眼，嘴边也扬起了一抹笑意。
慕迟曜走了过去，弯腰坐下，脸色在酒吧的灯光下，有些看不太真切。
“喝什么？”沈北城问，“老规矩，还是换点口味？”

> Chapter 19 Get Out (Page 1)
Yan Anxi also sat up and quickly covered herself with a bathrobe.
"I have my own arrangements for many things. Don't try to speculate on me." He dropped these words and walked outside without stopping.
Seeing him striding away, Yan Anxi panicked and couldn't care about anything else. She quickly climbed out of bed with bare feet, chased after him, and tightly hugged Mu Chi Yao's strong waist from behind.
"I was wrong, don't leave... I won't talk any more, Mu Chi Yao, whatever you say is whatever you say, I have absolutely no objection."
Yan Anxi quickly admitted her mistake. If Mu Chi Yao was so angry with her tonight, she would probably have a hard time in the future.
Mu Chi Yao held too many important things in her hands.
But he snorted coldly and opened her fingers one by one: "Let go."
Yan Anxi refused: "Don't be angry with me. I was wrong. I was wrong. You think I didn't say anything..."
Yan Anxi staggered back two steps before barely standing still.
Mu Chi Yao had already strode out and slammed the door shut.
Okay, Yan Anxi thought, it's over, she really made him angry. It seemed that she shouldn't try to guess Mu Chi Yao's thoughts.
So now that he has left, there is nothing she can do. She can only coax him tomorrow?
Yes, coaxing, she could only coax this man Mu Chi Yao and pretend to be well-behaved.
Now that she has come this far, no matter what happens in the future, she must bite the bullet and go on.
Yan Anxi didn't think about it anymore. She was tired enough. She turned back to the bed and fell asleep soon.
Mu Chi Yao returned to his room, changed his clothes, took the car keys, raised his hand and looked at the time, it was already eleven o'clock in the night.
He turned around and walked out. When he saw the closed bedroom door opposite, his eyes froze slightly, and his already resolute outline suddenly became even colder.
Mu Chi Yao walked out of Nianhua Villa, started the car, and drove straight out without stopping for a moment.
Mu Chi Yao stopped the car, and someone immediately came forward and opened the door for him first: "Mr. Mu."
He threw away the car keys and asked casually: "Who is here?"
Mu Chi Yao nodded slightly and walked in directly.
This is a high-end private VIP bar, known as the most expensive bar in Mucheng. Because all the people coming and going are the dignitaries of Mucheng and the rich ladies of Mucheng, there are security guards within a hundred meters of the bar, and ordinary people cannot approach easily.
And this bar, located in a prime location in Mucheng, is just an inconspicuous small industry under the Mushi Group.
As soon as Mu Chi Yao walked in, he heard someone whistle: "Hey, this is not President Mu Da. Why do you have time to come here for a drink today?"
Sitting in an exclusive seat not far from the bar, were two very noble and handsome men.
The one whistling was Shen Beicheng, the eldest son of the Shen family and Mu Chi Yao's friend for many years.
Li Yanjin, who was next to Shen Beicheng, also raised his head, glanced at Mu Chi Yao lightly, and a smile appeared on his lips.
Mu Chi Yao walked over and bent down to sit down. His face was a bit unclear under the light of the bar.
"What to drink?" Shen Beicheng asked, "Stick to the same rules, or should we change the taste?"
